This was held at Charlton Park Track on Saturday, May 11th, and the 100 Yards was won by H.

Held on Wednesday evening, August 21st, it was a five-sided Inter-Club Match, and some very keen competition was seen. H. Wickerson, running for Cambridge H., won the 100 Yards with George Pallett beating Dicky Dumbrill for second place.
